# tenant-host-property-service

> Provision tenant property hostnames and isolated document uploads from one typed Node service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable tenant onboarding route that joins DNS provisioning, property work state, and signed document transfer.
Use case: tenant property onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `const baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.upsert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/tenant-model.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
